hainan-2026.name: 2026 Hainan Island International Film Festival
hainan-2026.sub: The 8th Hainan Island International Film Festival
hainan-2026.blurb: Dec 6–12 in Sanya, themed “Many Wonders of the Sea, Cinema Leading the Future”. Co-hosted by China Media Group and the Hainan Provincial Government, with 11 sections including the Golden Coconut competition and screenings. Jury president: Ruben Östlund; festival ambassador: Audrey Tautou. Plans 100–120 films in 250–295 screenings, with Egypt, Greece, Serbia, Thailand, ASEAN and Hong Kong, China spotlights and a retrospective of the jury president. Weekend extension screenings in Sanya and Haikou follow the closing. Lineup and schedule will be added once announced.

tiantan-tour-2026.name: 2026 BJIFF Tour
tiantan-tour-2026.sub: Tiantan Image · International Films National Tour
tiantan-tour-2026.blurb: Eight acclaimed films from world cinema, chosen through a mix of a core list and city-specific picks, tour five Chinese cities after the 16th Beijing International Film Festival. Their themes span tenderness, growing up, parting, redemption and women's stories: Dragonfly finds a glimmer of resilience in hardship; Our Girls presses on the limits of human decency; Two People in One Life and a Dog portrays the long warmth of an ordinary life together; Isabel is a leap of faith toward a new self; Ky Nam Inn hides an unspoken longing in old Saigon; Three Goodbyes teaches reconciliation with regret; In My Parents' House asks about the silence of family; and The Summer Book finds tenderness for life and nature in island summer light. Stripped of heavy drama, they read like a gentle visual essay. Each city's line-up depends on local scheduling and will be announced later.

wutianming-2026.name: 2026 Wu Tianming Young Film Festival
wutianming-2026.blurb: Eight masterworks of French realism in three sections: Masters' Debut, Mirrors of the Era and Cinema Today. They run from Malle's prelude to the New Wave, through the social realism of Kassovitz, the Dardennes and Doillon, to the present-day echoes of Haneke, Ladj Ly, Triet and Farhadi. On screen, yesterday is never far. The films screen in Jiaxing (November 20–25). Tickets go on sale at 12:00 noon on November 13 on Taopiaopiao.

ui.排片、专题、片目与我的护照怎么用: How to use Schedule, Programmes, Films and My passport
ui.底栏四个入口：「排片」看每天每家影院的场次，「专题」按影展、单元浏览，「片目」查: The bottom bar has four tabs: Schedule shows screenings by day and cinema, Programmes browses by festival and section, Films lists every title, and Me holds your plan, passport and settings.
ui.排片页把每天每家影院的场次排成时间表，一个色块就是一场放映；点色块看影片详情与购: The schedule lays out every cinema’s screenings by day; each block is one screening. Tap a block for film details and ticket or sign-up info, and filter by day, cinema or programme (multi-select).
ui.点色块右上角的 + 把场次加入个人排片；「我的」里会按天列出日程并自动检查时间冲: Tap the + on a block to add it to your plan. Me lists your plan by day and flags time clashes, and the schedule can show only your picks.
ui.专题页把影片按影展、单元归档，点进去看简介和片单，也能看到自己在这个专题里看过几: Programmes groups films by festival and section. Open one for its intro and line-up, and see how many you have watched and how complete it is.
ui.片目页收录全部影片，可以搜片名、导演、演员，并按专题、城市、放映版本筛选；点进影: Films lists every title. Search by title, director or cast, filter by programme, city or format, and open a film for its synopsis, credits, honours and screenings.
ui.在影片页点「看过」盖下印章，可以打分、选放映版本；再看一次就点「再看一次」，每次: Tap Watched on a film page to stamp it, rate it and pick a format. Watch it again and tap “Watch again”; each viewing keeps its own date, rating and format.
ui.可以记录你是在普通影厅、胶片、IMAX、杜比、巨幕、LED 还是沉浸厅看的，之后: Record whether you watched in a standard hall, on film, IMAX, Dolby, a large-format, LED or immersive screen; it counts toward the Screens & formats medals.
ui.护照里的「成长」按看过的不同影片数升级（最高 20 级），并按奖项、口味、习惯、: Growth in the passport levels you up by distinct films watched (up to 20 levels) and lights medals in seven categories: awards, taste, habits, screens, rewatching, journeys and easter eggs. Each medal explains how to earn it.
ui.放映所在的城市、国家和大洲会自动在「足迹」里点亮，每座城市还会显示各专题的观看进: Cities, countries and continents where you watched light up automatically in Footprints, with your progress per programme in each city.
ui.已加一次观影 · 可补日期、版本和评分: Viewing added — set its date, format and rating
ui.盖下第一枚印章，就此入场: Stamp your first film to begin
ui.看过的影片落在哪座城市，这里就会点亮一座城市。: Cities light up here as you stamp films screened in them.
ui.每册最多 285 枚印章，满了自动换下一册。: Each volume holds up to 285 stamps, then a new one begins.
ui.每本护照最多 285 枚印章（20 页），满了自动换下一册；按观影日期从早到晚排: Each passport holds up to 285 stamps (20 pages); when it is full a new volume begins. Stamps run by viewing date, and covers change colour from Volume 2. Open “Passport shelf” under Me to switch volumes once you have more than one.
ui.在「我的」里展开「我的观影护照」，点封面即可翻开；左右滑动或点上一页 / 下一页: Expand “My film passport” under Me and tap the cover. Swipe or use Previous / Next to turn pages. On iPad landscape or an unfolded foldable it opens as a two-page spread, like a real book.
ui.在影片页点「看过」，护照里就会盖下这部片的印章；每部片的印章形状和颜色各不相同，: Tap “Watched” on a film page to stamp it into your passport. Every film gets its own stamp shape and colour; tap a stamp to jump back to the film.
ui.每部片可打 0–10 分（半颗星为 1 分），分数会印在章上；观影日期默认取你已: Rate each film from 0 to 10 (a half star is 1 point); the score is printed on the stamp. The viewing date defaults to a screening in your plan and can be changed to the day you really watched.
ui.护照首页点姓名可以改成自己的名字，也能从相册放一张照片；姓名会同步显示在护照底部: Tap the name on the first page to write your own, and add a photo from your album. Your name also appears in the machine-readable lines at the foot of the page.
ui.资料页汇总看过影片、专题、影院数、平均评分、首枚与最近印章和银幕总时长；印章每页: The data page sums up films seen, programmes, cinemas, average rating, first and latest stamp and total screen time. Each stamp page holds up to 15 stamps, then a new page opens.
ui.在排片表点色块右上角的 + 加入场次；「我的」里会按天列出日程并自动检查时间冲突: Tap + on a block in the timetable to add a show. Me lists your plan by day and checks for time clashes; the timeline can show only your plan and be filtered by programme.
ui.排片页和片目页的筛选都可以多选，比如同时看几天、几家影院或几个专题，更快找到想看: Filters on the timetable and film pages accept several choices at once, such as multiple days, cinemas or programmes, so you can find shows faster.
ui.在「我的」里可以单独打开「已加入排片」和「已看过」两份片单，回顾想看的与看过的。: Open the Planned and Watched lists from Me to review what you want to see and what you have seen.
ui.把排片生成带二维码的长图、分享链接或加入日历（网页版另支持 PDF），发给一起看: Turn your plan into a QR poster, a share link or calendar events (PDF on the web), and send it to friends who watch with you.
ui.护照页底部「生成我的影院观影结算」，可按年份、月份、专题筛选，生成一张印章墙长图: Use “Generate my cinema recap” under the passport. Filter by year, month or programme to get a stamp-wall poster, perfect for year-end or after each festival.
ui.开启上方云端同步，另一台设备用同步码即可带走看过记录、评分、照片和排片。同步码请: Turn on cloud sync above; enter the sync code on another device to bring over watched films, ratings, photo and plan. Keep the code safe: it cannot be recovered from your name.
ui.可以下载一份完整备份（含观影记录、评分、照片、姓名和排片，不含同步码），导入时会: Download a full backup (watched films, ratings, photo, name and plan; no sync code). Importing merges your plan and, for the same film, the backup record wins.
ui.右上角可切换中文 / English；网页版可「添加到手机」放到桌面像 App: Switch between 中文 and English at the top. The web version can be added to your home screen like an app (use Floating Window in WeChat). Report schedule errors under “Feedback & corrections”.
